title: Enterprise Ask Hub + Scope Checklist for Sales/CS Feature Requests
creator: Daniel Kim
description:
Summary: Create a lightweight, repeatable intake hub and initial scoping checklist for Sales and Customer Success enterprise feature asks (non-bug) so PMs can quickly aggregate requests, run a consistent prioritization, and produce a scoping recommendation for Eng/Design.

Problem: Sales/CS regularly surface feature asks from enterprise customers that require cross-team alignment (Dedicated, Private, Console). Current intake is ad-hoc: asks arrive via email, Slack, and one-off docs, which leads to duplicated work, unclear priority, and late discovery of security/compliance blockers.

Goal: Build a single source (hub) + checklist that captures the ask, context, customer constraints, and an initial feasibility/priority score. Output should be a one-pager scoping note with recommended next action (pilot, design spike, discovery, decline).

Scope: This ticket covers the PM-side template, triage rubric, handoff protocol with ENG/DES/SE, a small pilot with two Sales accounts, and creation of a Confluence intake page and a lightweight Zendesk/Sheets form. Implementation of ingestion automation (Salesforce sync) is out of scope for this ticket and will be a follow-up (owner: GTM Ops).
intake_form_fields: Business objective (why this matters, KPIs impacted)
Existing workaround or priority from CS/Sales
Attested security controls required (KMS/HSM, audit logs)
Contacts: AE, AM, Solution Engineer, Customer PM
triage_rubric: Revenue impact: 3 points (>= $1M ARR), 2 points (>= $250k), 1 point (other)
Compliance/regulatory: critical override if true (e.g., data residency, SOC/PPCI)
Launch blocker: 2 points if ask is required for existing contract go-live
Strategic fit: 0-3 points against 3 prioritized pillars (Reliability, Cost Predictability, Private Deployments)
Engineering effort: estimated T-shirt (S/M/L/XL) during quick ENG review
Customer concentration risk: high if single-customer-depends-on-feature
acceptance_criteria: Confluence 'Enterprise Ask Hub' page created and linked from Sales playbook
Intake form published (Google Form + Zendesk macro) and validated with 2 AE/CS users
Triaged backlog created in Linear with PM recommendation and priority score
Pilot: initial scoping notes for 2 enterprise requests produced and reviewed by ENG/DES
Handoff protocol documented and a PRD template linked
sample_requests: Customer A (Healthcare): needs VPC-only deployment with FIPS KMS integration; timeline tied to contract signing (high urgency)
Customer B (Fintech): asks for predictable throughput SLA and per-route cost breakdown in console (medium urgency)
Customer C (SaaS): requests auto-failover across regions for Dedicated pools (low urgency, but impacts reliability pillar)
decisions: Decision 1 (2026-03-05): Use Confluence as canonical hub and a lightweight Google Form for initial intake to avoid heavy infra changes.
Decision 2 (2026-03-07): All new enterprise asks must include a 'deployment mode' selection to surface Private/Dedicated requirements early.
Decision 3 (2026-03-10): Triage rubric will include a hard 'compliance' override; any compliance-related request triggers immediate Security review and escalates to P0 if contract-blocker.
